name: A Scribbled Letter

angles.text: Tordrin Stemblade mentors hunters at Northshire Abbey. He notes how times have changed as new races take up the bow to defend Stormwind from beasts and vermin.
Training skilled defenders at Northshire Abbey helps secure Elwynn Forest against encroaching kobolds and other growing threats to Stormwind.

faq.answer: After clashes with kobold camps, adventurers at Northshire Abbey receive a letter sealed by Tordrin Stemblade. It directs them to seek his mentorship and training in the valley.
Tordrin Stemblade sent the letter. He is a local trainer at Northshire Abbey, where he instructs fledgling adventurers learning their craft.
Tordrin Stemblade can be found at Northshire Abbey in Northshire Valley. He remains there day and night, ready to offer travelers instruction and advice.
faq.q: Where can Tordrin Stemblade be found?

aliases: why did tordrin send a letter
faq.answer: After an adventurer proves capable against local kobolds, Tordrin sends word so they can receive proper training. He aims to prepare them for the growing dangers threatening Northshire’s residents and the wider realm of Stormwind.
faq.q: Why did Tordrin Stemblade send the letter?

faq.answer: Northshire Valley faces incursions from aggressive kobold camps and dangerous man-eating beasts roaming the surrounding woods. Local mentors muster and drill capable fighters in response.
faq.q: What threats are currently affecting Northshire?

faq.answer: Tordrin offers continuous training and guidance. He urges adventurers to learn the lay of the land and assist local folk with the kingdom’s many troubles.
faq.q: What does Tordrin Stemblade offer after receiving the letter?

sections.body: After clashes with kobold camps in the valley, adventurers at Northshire Abbey receive a hasty letter sealed by Tordrin Stemblade. It asks them to give it prompt attention before taking up other business. The summons brings budding champions to formal mentorship within the abbey’s protective grounds.
sections.title: A Summons in Northshire

sections.body: Tordrin Stemblade says times have changed. Unfamiliar folk now take up weapons to defend the realm. As the wilderness around Northshire grows more dangerous by the day, he offers travelers counsel day or night. He guides them as they master their skills and help Stormwind’s beleaguered people.
sections.title: Guidance in Perilous Times

summary: At Northshire Abbey, adventurers receive a summons from Tordrin Stemblade after clashes with nearby kobolds. It calls promising recruits to seek his training as Stormwind faces growing dangers.
